subject: design/argus-write-hook
statement: Each supported CLI is wired to the canonical deny decision through its **own pre-write hook surface**, configured as a per-CLI adapter on the vendor-neutral surface, each explicitly **fail-closed**; a CLI with no honoring hook is listed with the merge-boundary backstop as its guarantee *(design-brainstorm:argus-boundary-enforcement-tech-design#D-4; basis FR-3, UB-2, NR-3)*.
